engine_policy: Engine identity is read from each replay meta; no engine extraction beyond these six source files.
notes: Round milestones use extracted round-end arrays; team spent gold is the sum of negative shop transaction deltas through that round, while final spentGold comes from native final champion statistics.
Priority values are round-end snapshots, not action-time Set priority; they do not establish causal camp aggro or double-turn priority.
Opening capture actor attribution comes from capture share records. All observed Mite-side champion captures are listed, with event round and group ID.
